fact: A national digital skills, AI and cybersecurity training programme for at least 20,000 Liberians, led by the Liberia Cyber Crime Prevention and Mitigation Agency, is listed as pipeline, starting 2026-10-01.
title: Cyber Liberia 2030: National Digital Skills, Artificial Intelligence, and Cybersecurity Initiative for Youth Employment and Economic Transformation
